# tachy bash completion
#
# Install for the current user:
#   mkdir -p ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions
#   tachy generate completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/tachy
# (picked up by bash-completion on the next shell; without the package,
# source the file from ~/.bashrc)
#
# Regenerated by hand from the CLI surface — tests/generate.d fails
# `dub test` when a command word or option is missing from here.

_tachy()
{
    local cur prev
    COMPREPLY=()
    cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
    prev="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD-1]}"

    # the command word: the first word that is neither an option nor an
    # option's value (options may appear before and after the command)
    local i cmd=""
    for (( i=1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++ )); do
        case "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" in
            -i|--inventory|--config|--identity|--address|--port|--direct-report)
                ((i++))
                ;;
            -*)
                ;;
            *)
                cmd="${COMP_WORDS[i]}"
                break
                ;;
        esac
    done

    # completed positionals after the command word (0 = the word being
    # completed is the first one)
    local nargs=0
    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then
        local j
        for (( i=0; i < COMP_CWORD; i++ )); do
            [ "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" = "$cmd" ] || continue
            for (( j=i+1; j < COMP_CWORD; j++ )); do
                case "${COMP_WORDS[j]}" in
                    -i|--inventory|--config|--identity|--address|--port|--direct-report)
                        ((j++))
                        ;;
                    -*)
                        ;;
                    *)
                        ((nargs++))
                        ;;
                esac
            done
            break
        done
    fi

    # selection candidates: all, host names, @tags — from the inventory
    # (no host is contacted), honoring -i on this command line
    local inv=()
    for (( i=1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++ )); do
        case "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" in
            -i|--inventory)
                inv=( "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" "${COMP_WORDS[i+1]}" )
                break
                ;;
        esac
    done
    local cands
    cands=$(tachy hosts list --completion ${inv[@]:+"${inv[@]}"} 2>/dev/null)
    local names
    names=$(echo "$cands" | grep -v '^@' | grep -vx all)

    # option values
    case "$prev" in
        -i|--inventory|--config|--identity|--direct-report)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
            return 0
            ;;
        --address|--port)
            return 0
            ;;
    esac

    # options
    if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "-i --inventory -v --verbose --color --direct \
            --direct-report --events --keep-bundle --config --identity \
            --address --port --no-browser --completion -y --yes -h --help" -- "$cur") )
        return 0
    fi

    case "$cmd" in
        "")
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "apply a check c hosts generate g webui \
                webdoc man version v help upgrade" -- "$cur") )
            ;;
        apply|check|a|c)
            if [ "$nargs" -eq 0 ]; then
                # comma-separated selection: complete the last element
                local pre="" part="$cur"
                if [[ "$cur" == *,* ]]; then
                    pre="${cur%,*},"
                    part="${cur##*,}"
                fi
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cands" -- "$part") )
                COMPREPLY=( "${COMPREPLY[@]/#/$pre}" )
            fi
            # later positionals are tasks files: default file completion
            ;;
        hosts)
            case "$prev" in
                info)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$names" -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
                list)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cands" -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
                *)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "list info" -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
            esac
            ;;
        generate)
            case "$prev" in
                completions)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "bash zsh fish" -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
                generate)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "key task config project completions" -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
                *)
                    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
                    ;;
            esac
            ;;
        help)
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "apply check hosts generate webui webdoc \
                man version upgrade help" -- "$cur") )
            ;;
    esac
}
complete -F _tachy tachy
